mapper.select: SELECT Person.PersonGuid AS id, Refn.Text AS refn, Person.FullNameReversed AS name, Person.ID AS pkid, Birth.Date AS dateBirth, Death.Date AS dateDeath, ( SELECT F.Text FROM Fact F WHERE F.LinkTableID = 5 AND F.LinkID = Person.ID AND F.Preferred = 1 AND F.FactTypeID IN (SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Abbreviation = '_XY') LIMIT 1 ) xy, ( SELECT F.Text FROM Fact F WHERE F.LinkTableID = 5 AND F.LinkID = Person.ID AND F.Preferred = 1 AND F.FactTypeID IN (SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Name = 'Name') LIMIT 1 ) gedcomname, ( SELECT F.Text FROM Fact F WHERE F.LinkTableID = 5 AND F.LinkID = Person.ID AND F.Preferred = 1 AND F.FactTypeID IN (SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Name = 'Sex') LIMIT 1 ) sex, ( SELECT P.Name FROM Fact F INNER JOIN Place P ON (P.ID = F.PlaceID) WHERE F.LinkTableID = 5 AND F.LinkID = Person.ID AND F.Preferred = 1 AND F.FactTypeID IN (SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Name = 'Birth') LIMIT 1 ) birthplace, ( SELECT Name FROM ( SELECT F.Date, P.Name FROM Fact F INNER JOIN Place P ON (P.ID = F.PlaceID) WHERE F.LinkTableID = 5 AND F.LinkID = Person.ID AND F.Date IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT F.Date, P.Name FROM Relationship R INNER JOIN Fact F ON (F.LinkID = R.ID AND F.LinkTableID = 7) INNER JOIN Place P ON (P.ID = F.PlaceID) WHERE (R.Person1ID = Person.ID OR R.Person2ID = Person.ID) AND F.Date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Date LIMIT 1) ) anyplace FROM Person LEFT OUTER JOIN Fact AS Refn ON ( Refn.LinkTableID = 5 AND Refn.LinkID = Person.ID AND Refn.Preferred > 0 AND Refn.FactTypeID IN ( SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Abbreviation = '_ID' LIMIT 1 ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN Fact AS Birth ON ( Birth.LinkTableID = 5 AND Birth.LinkID = Person.ID AND Birth.Preferred > 0 AND Birth.FactTypeID IN ( SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Name = 'Birth' LIMIT 1 ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN Fact AS Death ON ( Death.LinkTableID = 5 AND Death.LinkID = Person.ID AND Death.Preferred > 0 AND Death.FactTypeID IN ( SELECT ID FROM FactType WHERE FactType.Name = 'Death' LIMIT 1 ) )
